subject: Pen test kickoff & scope update for Acme integration
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: RedShield Labs <secops@redshieldlabs.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@redshieldlabs.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pen test kickoff & scope for Acme integration

Hi Daniel / RedShield team,

Thanks again for agreeing to run the external penetration test for our Acme Corp integration (agreement signed 2026-02-26). We want to kick off initial scoping and lock a test window the week of Mar 23. High-level asks: 

- Confirm external surface to be tested: public webapp (app.acme.example), API gateway (api.acme.example), and the customer data ingestion endpoint (ingest.acme.example).
- Confirm whether authenticated testing (authenticated user session) is in scope — we expect to allow a limited test account.
- List access needs (IP allowlists, credentials, VPN/Jumphost) and any lead time you require.
- Deliverables: executive summary, full findings with repro steps, and a retest verification report after remediation.

I've attached the draft scope (redshield_scope_v1.pdf) and a short kickoff notes file. Internal folks: Vivek, Rishi — FYI on technical contacts and credentials. Irene — please flag any legal/contract points.

Next steps: Daniel, can you propose 2x 90-minute kickoff slots next week? We need to finalize the window by Mar 10 so Acme can schedule support.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redshield_scope_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 95 KB)
Attachment: redshield_kickoff_notes.txt (text/plain, 3 KB)

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@redshieldlabs.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, RedShield Labs <secops@redshieldlabs.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test kickoff & scope for Acme integration

Neha — thanks for the clear summary. We can support the scope you outlined. Answers inline and a few follow-ups below.

- Surface: app.acme.example, api.acme.example, ingest.acme.example — confirmed.
- Authenticated testing: we request one test account with standard user privileges and a second account with manager privileges to validate horizontal privilege escalation paths. Please confirm if both are available.
- Access needs: public IP addresses for our test runners (we will provide list), a temporary VPN jump host for internal-only endpoints, and SSO test user or SAML assertion if possible. Our minimum lead time for allowlist changes is 48 hours.
- Deliverables: Executive summary + findings + remediation verification retest (48-72 hour turnaround for retest after receiving fixes). We will include CVSS and exploitability guidance.

Proposed kickoff slots (PST): 
- Thu Mar 12, 10:00-11:30
- Fri Mar 13, 14:00-15:30

We did a quick pass on the scope doc and added comments — see Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=redshield-scope-doc.

Action items for Redwood: provide test accounts, confirm SSO approach, and add our test runner IPs to the allowlist by Mar 21 if you select the week of Mar 23.

Regards,
Daniel Park
Principal Consultant, RedShield Labs

Attachment: none

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@redshieldlabs.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test kickoff & scope for Acme integration

Thanks Daniel — good to see the slots. A couple of scope clarifications from the infra side: 

1) The ingest endpoint sits behind our internal CDN and requires a signed API key. We will provision two signed keys: one labeled redshield-test-user and one redshield-test-admin. Keys will expire after the scheduled window.
2) We need to exclude the internal admin console (admin.internal.redwood.local) — that host is not reachable from public internet and is out-of-scope. Please ensure your team will not attempt to pivot to private management interfaces.
3) We are adding a second subdomain (dashboard.acme.example) that was not in the original scope. Rishi — please coordinate with Acme to confirm whether dashboard should be included.

Neha — can we push the kickoff to Fri Mar 13 14:00-15:30 PST to give infra time to provision keys and the allowlist?

Vivek
CTO, Redwood Inference

---
On Wed, Mar 4, 2026 at 11:02 AM Daniel Park <daniel.park@redshieldlabs.com> wrote:
> Neha — thanks for the clear summary. We can support the scope you outlined...

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@redshieldlabs.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test kickoff & scope for Acme integration

Quick update: Acme confirmed dashboard.acme.example is in scope and will provide two SSO test users (standard + admin). I've created a short runbook for the test window with credential handling and allowlist steps. See attached stub and Jira ticket reference below.

Key details: 
- Test window: Mon Mar 23 - Fri Mar 27 (RedShield may select 48-hour contiguous window inside this range).
- Test accounts: redshield-user / redshield-admin (SSO-enabled)
- Allowlist: firewall change scheduled for Mar 21 02:00 UTC — will add RedShield IPs then.
- Sensitive hosts excluded: admin.internal.redwood.local (explicitly out-of-scope).

I'll post the runbook to the security-runbooks folder and open INF-789 for tracking. Daniel, please confirm if you need SSH access or only HTTP/S + API keys for the ingest endpoint.

Attachment: acme_test_guide_stub.pdf (application/pdf, 28 KB)
Related link: JIRA-INF-789

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@redshieldlabs.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Acme Corp Security <security@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test kickoff & scope for Acme integration

All — confirmed. We will not attempt to access private internal-only hosts (admin.internal.redwood.local). Our runners will use HTTP/S and API key flows; no SSH required. We appreciate SSO test users — please share assertion instructions or a temporary SAML cert.

Deliverable schedule: 
- Preliminary findings (triage) within 3 business days after our test window.
- Full report (with repro steps and remediation guidance) within 10 business days.
- Retest verification after fixes delivered: 3 business days.

We will upload the final report to your secure share and provide a huntable CSV of findings. Expect file names: redshield_acme_report_2026-03-xx.pdf and redshield_acme_findings_2026-03-xx.csv.

Next actions: Neha to confirm kickoff slot (we'll send calendar invite), Rishi to upload runbook link to JIRA INF-789, Acme to share SSO details.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Principal Consultant, RedShield Labs

Attachment: none
